<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the protonated ion appears at m/z 114.06808. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ~113.0608 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed isotopic pattern (≈6 % M+1 and ≈0.6 % M+2, consistent with ~6 carbons and two oxygens) is C₆H₉O₂. This fits the mass within <1 mDa and explains the isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
